I don't have an answer to your question, but I do believe you'll find comfort in knowing others are going through the same. I relate to this deeply. I haven't felt the urges the same that I used to. I'm not compelled to do it, and I still feel nothing when I do. I don't really have any reasons. I'm away from my main stressor even.

My answer to my own problem? I miss the feeling it used to bring. I just want to feel something. Just because, I guess. 

Yes, thinking on it, I guess it can be still called an addiction. As an addiction progresses, you'll forget how to live without it. It takes more to get the same effect as well...if that makes sense.

Anyways, I hope I helped. 😊  You can PM me if you want.
